value.rationale: A universal mode-number ceiling independent of the number of positive colored-noise relaxation channels gives a falsifiable spectroscopy diagnostic. The sharp result separates multi-timescale forcing from multiple physical oscillation modes; it cannot be obtained simply by summing the established one-rate three-peak formulas because positive sums need not generally preserve extrema counts.
